title: Long-running active production sessions
description: Return exactly three columns: database_name, role_name, duration_seconds. Include only active production sessions lasting at least 300 seconds. Sort by duration_seconds DESC, then database_name ASC for ties.
starter_sql:
SELECT database_name, role_name, duration_seconds
FROM sessions
hints: Filter by state, environment, and minimum duration together.
Use two ORDER BY keys for a stable result.
solution_explanation: WHERE keeps only qualifying active production sessions and ORDER BY makes the result deterministic.
